# Solid Dictionary

_A dictionary web app built with SolidJS. 📖_

</div>

&nbsp;

## Why does this exist?
Built for a Premium Frontend Mentor challenge.

## How it looks

<img src="https://github.com/MindLaborDev/solidjs-dictionary-web-app/blob/master/src/assets/demo.jpg?raw=true" width="600" />

## How to run it

```bash
$ npm install
$ npm run dev
```

## Deployment

You can deploy the `dist` folder to any static host provider (netlify, surge, now, etc.)
